projects.title: Dejunk
projects.description: Dejunk is a browser extension that helps users declutter their online lives by allowing them to toggle the visibility of various elements on web pages, such as ads, pop-ups, and other distractions. It provides a simple interface for users to customize their browsing experience and focus on the content that matters most to them. As the sole developer, I designed and built the extension from scratch.
projects.shortBlurb: Browser extension to declutter online experiences by toggling visibility of web elements.

projects.title: Vega
projects.description: Vega is a web app designed to help job seekers more efficiently manage their job search. Using a companion browser extension, users can save job postings from any website to their Vega account. The app then helps them track their applications, interviews, and follow-ups through a kanban-style interface. It also provides a Find-a-Job features that allows users to quickly use Google queries to find jobs that match their criteria. As solo developer, I built the app and browser extension from the ground up.
projects.shortBlurb: Web app and browser extension to help job seekers manage their job search efficiently.

projects.title: StorySquad
projects.description: A mobile app designed to help kids spend time off screens engaging in analog creativity. Enables kids to enter hand-written stories to compete against each other. As Full Stack Engineer & Team Lead, I worked extensively on the app & led the team into the internal beta phase.
projects.shortBlurb: Mobile app for kids to engage in analog creativity through hand-written stories.

projects.title: HRF DocDB
projects.description: An internal research tool built for Human Rights First & The Pat Finucane Centre to help them manage, analyze, and search through scanned physical documents related to human rights violations. As Full-Stack Team Lead, I led the team through the project lifecycle, from initial requirements gathering to deployment. Then I implemented final features and polish, and shipped the project.
projects.shortBlurb: Internal research tool enabling search an analysis of physical documents.
